notes: «ح» splits two routes; they meet at Kathir, and the names written after him form the shared tail.
«- يعني ابن إسماعيل -» and «بمعناه» are an editor gloss and a wording note: left out.
Inside the dashes «قال كثير قال المطلب قال الذي يخبرني ذلك عن رسول الله» restates Kathir and Muttalib, then gives an unnamed informant of the Prophet's act: the last link is that unnamed informant.
